summary: Copies per-element buffer data between source and destination arrays using an interleaved offset pattern. For each element in this+0x20 elements, computes a scaled copy size from element descriptors, then copies blocks backward and forward across stride positions to mirror each element across adjacent slots. Returns the final element index.
